# FDGD008

> PERMITTED: Unsealing a Sealed Type

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section D.6.2 Unsealing a Sealed Type. Applies to: reflection break.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application none, test none
- Status: draft

Only metadata such as `Type.IsSealed` changes. PublicApiAnalyzers (optional in /fdg-setup) can flag changes to the public API.

## From the book

The only potentially breaking impact of unsealing a sealed type is in metadata such as `Type.IsSealed`. Reflection loads may misidentify your type or mishandle data based on that metadata.

The .NET BCL team considers this an acceptable breaking change.
